carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One item of hand baggage, maximum 55 cm in length x 35 cm in width x 25 cm in depth (wheels and handles included).

carryon_weight.value: Maximum 8 kg on ATR72 aircraft and 12 kg on Airbus A320s.

personal_item.value: Plus possibly one or two accessories such as a handbag or briefcase, a camera or a small portable computer, which must fit under the seat in front of you. A suit bag counts as standard cabin baggage, not an accessory.

atr_restriction.value: ATR72 flights have limited cabin stowage; you may be asked to hand your bag over at the foot of the aircraft and collect it after landing.

piece_weight_economy.notes: Air Corsica Economy Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_business.notes: Air Corsica Business Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_first.notes: Air Corsica First Class checked baggage allowance.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Air Corsica's conditions of carriage refer cancellations, long delays and denied boarding to EU Regulation 261/2004.

cancellation.value: If your flight is cancelled, Air Corsica provides immediate assistance and compensation under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, unless the cancellation is due to extraordinary circumstances.

delay.value: For a significant delay against the departure time on your ticket, Air Corsica provides immediate assistance under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, unless due to extraordinary circumstances. Its conditions state that no compensation is payable for a delay.
delay.notes: Quoted from Article 12.2(c) of the carrier's conditions of carriage; this is the carrier's own statement, not a statement of EU law.

refund.value: After a cancellation, significant delay or denied boarding within the meaning of Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, the refund is made within seven days, at the ticket price, for the legs of the journey not flown.

denied_boarding.value: If you are refused boarding against your will, Air Corsica compensates you under article 7 of Regulation No. 261/2004 and offers assistance under articles 8 and 9.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs

airport_cutoff.value: Be at the check-in desk or departure gate by the deadline: 30 minutes before departure of a domestic flight and 40 minutes before an international flight. Otherwise your reservation may be cancelled and your seat given to another passenger.

modules.lede: Check-in deadlines vary from one airport to another; Air Corsica gives the deadline for your first flight in writing.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
